remaining_code: Original-component layouts, calling conventions and register dataflow

Security runtime and complete used KPI ABI, physical boot/interrupt entropy provider health, SM8750 PMGR/security-state mapping and authenticated-root policy. Fresh RAW EFI RNG handoff code, full separate firmware/container and actual EFI C to native SecureDT/PE/early-PRNG/original-POST chain are checked offline. The proprietary RNG/firmware/ExitBootServices remain peers in execution, and no Qualcomm security-state provider is supplied.

Qualify implemented UFS/completion/matching and root-window publication, original authenticated APFS root and the default-off init Data mount route. Exact 2/3 GiB formatting, ordinary iPhone mount requests and actual source RamBlock start-to-I/O/selector paths are checked offline. Full original parent/IORegistry/IOMedia publication and matching, APFS mount/crypto/power and actual writable Data remain unqualified.

Qualify actual publication and execution of the implemented real-class GOP factory and opt-in IOBSD worker; real original loader/user-client/IOSurfaceRoot matching and termination, AA569 power and remaining display ABI

Qualify target S3910 HBP/LBP/SPI, GPIO/VDD/clock/SMMU/DMA/reset and orientation; complete shared clock/power-domain/electrical policy and full hardware takeover beyond validated GPIO, stopped SE4 XO, empty QUP4 stock SPI loading and terminal transfer recovery. Live clocks use locked GPLL0 L/alpha/postdivision and RCG M/N/DFS rates; warm adoption refuses residual ownership. DMA now requires data/command/idle and bounded cancel/abort/reset ACK, with sticky failure and no reuse. Original C HID parser/cleanup and source report metadata execute offline. Source start/stop is gated and reentrant stop drains callbacks with a retained provider; original parent start/stop, matching and HID submission remain peers. Bounded event accessors, children pointer and default dispatch are now qualified across 32 CPU paths; 71 original data-only bindings are prepared separately. A 552-byte/219-slot source edge subclass now annotates via qualified original APIs, with Kernel __kernel__ metadata/personality, first-init retention and guarded duplicate cleanup. 300 source sanitizer and 40 actual source/original/native CPU paths pass, including metadata errors, constructor/destructor and unsafe original free at 0x18 controls. Qualify full original parent/device lifecycle, element/matching/client ordering and actual edge/UI behavior.

Qualify board startup and the A830/concrete-display candidate; complete private graphics/client ABI and trusted IOSurface identity/task/page authorization before actual producer registration, asynchronous grant, signalling and cancellation. Whole-VM job leases and bounded lock-free publisher map waiting are now implemented and checked in an isolated source/native/prelink/container route; they do not provide physical CPU/device exclusion or cache/reset proof. Exact original notification algorithms, sync aliases and the preserved fresh-health frontend remain checked offline. Full original surface allocation/+5056 lifecycle, networking, audio, power, charging and thermal services remain incomplete or unqualified.
scope: Local code/dependency/build preparation for CPH2653 and iPhone10,3 / 20H392, without phone operations. All 504 earlier artifacts, 70 private first-pass artifacts, staged content and 29 upstream source revision/worktree digests are preserved. The new kernel-only owned-descriptor adapter checks the exact original surface descriptor identity, allocation rounding, direction, length and every imported 4K physical page. It independently prepares/holds descriptor, surface identity and real native GPU memory. Observed backing replacement/resize refuses; VM/job references defer unprepare; complete failure retains and quarantines ownership. Thirty-five ASan/UBSan cases and four source controls pass. A separate 94-object/102-entry/343-alias candidate preserves previous objects and strict prelink of 28 original components, seven interfaces and 63889 pointers. Twenty-five new actual-linked paths execute source association/rollback, native descriptor OSObject/tagged refs, native memory/VM job refs and original surface refs; five instruction controls are rejected. All 149 retained identity/GPU/notification/display successful paths rerun in the new kernel, totaling 174. Descriptor prepare/complete/physical segments, type checks and cache effects remain explicit peers; new VM cases use fixture mapping/TLB-quiescence operations, without real mapping/unmapping. The API requires the caller to already own the original descriptor through original-component serialization; borrowed getter results are only compared and are not retained unprotected. No public user ABI/capability or new boot image is added. 17 recorded new artifacts bring the total to 521. Original owned-descriptor acquisition and backing mutation/check-to-submit exclusion, GPU user-client import association, producer grant/callback/cancel/exit/completion, physical cache/reset and final object destruction remain incomplete or unqualified, as do full original graphics/runtime ABI, firmware entropy, policy/PMGR/authenticated root/Data, complete iOS startup and remaining peripherals.
